expected_behavior: Inventory and preserve semantic OpenXML structures while distinguishing package checks from rendering.

prompt: I have a reviewed DOCX, a Markdown copy, and several candidates but no clear authority; inspect them and decide the safe delivery round.
expected_behavior: Recover authorities and identities before editing or selecting a candidate.

prompt: Draft a new introduction in plain text from the supplied evidence.
expected_behavior: Route prose-only drafting to scientific writing.

prompt: Fix one typo in this ordinary README.md; there is no research delivery package or cross-format copy.
expected_behavior: Do not invoke rich research-document engineering for an ordinary Markdown edit.

prompt: Judge the scientific comments, revise the full document, clean the review markup, and produce a verified delivery copy.
expected_behavior: Compose writing adjudication with recoverable rich-document engineering and final identity checks.

prompt: Before I send this Word review and its numbered full-text folder, verify final hashes, parse every source, and remove locks, placeholders, and audit-only files.
expected_behavior: Compose document/package validation with evidence-source closure and bind both to final identities.

prompt: Deliver a genuinely clean Word copy: visible comments are gone, but inspect people or presence parts and preserve citation superscripts and punctuation-specific font runs.
expected_behavior: Check the full comment-family relationship closure and semantic run roles without claiming visual proof.

prompt: I revised a Word paragraph containing a formula and split one citation group; verify variable fonts, italics and vertical alignment without relying on aggregate superscript counts.
expected_behavior: Compare semantic run roles and formula structures rather than using a brittle total-count invariant.

prompt: I already submitted this report and now received a new comment; preserve the submitted hash, create a new revision identity, and record which checks must rerun.
expected_behavior: Freeze the exact baseline, branch a revision round, invalidate current checks, and persist authority.
